spec.name: Furniture Grave Marker
spec.description: A weathered stone grave marker with a stepped crown, carved crescent moon and moss-covered foundation. Eight connected cuboids form a grounded, compact silhouette. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits inside one block with generous edge clearance. Moon carving, cracks and moss are painted directly onto the stone; no text.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: weathered stone grave marker with carved moon and mossy base, no text. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
